## Why This Is Asked

- CKNE-to-resource mapping: rate limits, burst allowances, cache TTL, and eviction policies

## Code Example

```javascript
function mapCKNEtoPolicy(ckne) {
  const rate = Math.floor(1000 * ckne) + 100;
  const burst = Math.floor(50 * ckne) + 10;
  const cacheTTL = Math.floor(300 * (1 - ckne)) + 60;
  return { rate, burst, cacheTTL };
}
```

4. **Chaos Testing**: Introduce cache failures and verify graceful eviction behavior
5. **Performance Tests**: Confirm degradation loop executes within one-minute intervals

## Why This Is Asked

Assess ability to translate CKNE into concrete observability controls, ensuring fairness and SLA during latency changes.

## Key Concepts

- CKNE-to-telemetry mapping
- Per-tenant budgeted sampling and depth
- Real-time reallocation loop
- Telemetry reliability guarantees

## Code Example

```javascript
// Pseudo-mapping function
function mapCKNE(ckne){
  const sampling = 0.05 + ckne * 0.95; // 5% - 100%
  const depth = Math.round(1 + ckne * 2); // 1-3 levels
  const alert = 0.5 + ckne * 0.5; // 0.5 - 1.0 sensitivity
  return {sampling, depth, alert};
}
```
